description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a home screen in a web login application. It includes UI components such as app bar, success indication, settings page link, and embedded WebView for displaying a linked settings page.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Stateless widget representing the main screen displayed after user login, showing login success, settings access, and web view embedding for settings page.

classes.name: _SettingsLinkedWebView
classes.description: A stateful widget that embeds a WebView for displaying a settings page or URL, with reload and error handling functionalities.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including app bar, login success message, settings link, and logout button.

methods.name: _resolveTargetUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a full URL from a base URL and a relative or absolute path.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes WebViewController, sets JavaScript mode, background color, navigation delegate, and loads the target URL.
